info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Augite Pendant Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Augite Pendant Detail Creation API enables businesses to efficiently create detailed catalogs for augite pendants. This endpoint allows users to submit comprehensive information, including descriptions, specifications, and images for augite pendant products. Ideal for e-commerce platforms and inventory management systems, this API simplifies the process of enriching product listings and enhancing catalog accuracy. Typical consumers include product managers and developers looking to streamline inventory updates for jewelry collections.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to create new details for an Augite Pendant. It will accept the relevant data in the request body and store it in the system for future reference.

requestBody.description: Submit details for the Augite Pendant. This request body should include all necessary information required for processing the details related to the Augite Pendant. Ensure that the JSON structure adheres to the defined schema.

200.description: Request completed successfully and response returned.

CreateCatalogAugitePendantDetailRequest.title: Augite Pendant Details Request

augite_pendant_id.description: The unique identifier for the Augite pendant.

requestedBy.description: The name of the person requesting the Augite pendant.

quantity.description: The number of Augite pendants requested.

isPriority.description: Indicates whether the order is a priority request.

unitPrice.description: The price per unit of the Augite pendant.

CreateCatalogAugitePendantDetailRequest.description: Schema representing the request body for creating an Augite pendant order.
